name: Pipedrive
shortInfo: Prioritize deals, track performance and predict revenue
brief: Pipedrive is a cloud-based sales customer relationship management platforms. It help users prioritize deals, track performance and predict revenue. The Pipedrive Connector lets you sync data from Pipedrive API to your data warehouse automatically.
about:
The CRM platform to grow your business. The first CRM designed by salespeople, for salespeople. Do more to grow your business.  
  
Learn more about [Pipedrive API documentation.](https://www.pipedrive.com/)
availableData:
[Activities](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/pipedrive/pipelines/activities.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve all activities assigned to a particular user.

[Deals](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/pipedrive/pipelines/deals.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve all deals.

[Leads](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/pipedrive/pipelines/leads.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve all leads sorted by the time they were created, from oldest to newest.

[Notes](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/pipedrive/pipelines/notes.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve all notes.

[Products](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/pipedrive/pipelines/products.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the data about all products.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/pipedrive/index.html) here.
